∀ {P : Nat → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred.{1} P] (k : Nat),
  (∀ {m : Nat},
      Iff (Eq.{1} (Nat.findGreatest P k) m)
        (And (LE.le.{0} m k) (And (Ne.{1} m 0 → P m) (∀ ⦃n : Nat⦄, LT.lt.{0} m n → LE.le.{0} n k → Not (P n))))) →
    ∀ {m : Nat},
      Not (P (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)) →
        Iff (And (LE.le.{0} m k) (And (Ne.{1} m 0 → P m) (∀ ⦃n : Nat⦄, LT.lt.{0} m n → LE.le.{0} n k → Not (P n))))
          (And (LE.le.{0} m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
            (And (Ne.{1} m 0 → P m) (∀ ⦃n : Nat⦄, LT.lt.{0} m n → LE.le.{0} n (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1) → Not (P n))))
